Maya R: handing off evening oncall — quick FYI follow-ups from last postmortem (PM-2026-07 kv-cache-regression). most remediation tickets are in flight, summarizing below.

Dinesh: thanks — can you drop ticket IDs?

Maya R: sure:
- INC-5124: kv-cache resync fix (merged to main, deployed canary in prod-3)
- REM-231: add e2e for prefix-cache eviction
- DOC-78: update runbook threshold and alert text

Caroline: REM-231 looks green on CI but failing on staging load test, repro steps in the PR comments.

Maya R: noted. staging run at 17:30 showed CPU spike. @Dinesh can you verify the canary in prod-3 has stable tail latency?

Dinesh: quick check: prod-3 canary 2h back — p95 unchanged, p99 down ~120ms. I'll run another sample now.

ops-bot: deploy/rollout prod kv-cache-fix v1.3.2 to prod-3 — success — 2026-03-16T20:14Z

Dinesh: ran sampling script:
- tail latency p99 before: 980ms
- after: 860ms
- no error-rate increase, GC same

Jorge: FYI I hit a related error when simulating high-concurrency - stacktrace attached in thread (see gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/example) — likely unrelated but worth watching.

Maya R: thanks @Jorge. Filed follow-up REM-239 to investigate simulation artifact.

Caroline: another handoff item — oncall swaps: I'm swapping tomorrow morning with Alex M (cover 8am-4pm). @Maya R can you note any expected noisy alerts?

Maya R: main noisy alert expected: cache-eviction-rate > 5/s over 10m (false positives until DOC-78 lands). Also watch region-us-west for transient OOM during big batch runs.

Alex M: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye, can take ownership of REM-231 testing in staging.

Dinesh: small ask: can ops-alerts team lower alert sensitivity for cache-eviction for 24h window to reduce noise? tagging @Infra-SRE

Maya R: created ticket SRE-406 to temp-adjust alerting window — includes rollback at 24h. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-406

Infra-SRE: noted, will apply change at 21:00 UTC and monitor.

Maya R: verification plan for REM-231:
- run staging load with 2x concurrency for 2 hours
- compare p95/p99 and eviction metrics
- run canary in prod-3 for 4h before full rollout
Owner: Alex M
Status: in progress

Caroline: postmortem follow-up: should we reopen PM-2026-07 until REM-231 passes staging?

Dinesh: I'd prefer keep it open until both staging and canary hold for 24h.

Maya R: agreed — reopening PM-2026-07 and flagging REM-231 dependency. assigning to Alex M and Dinesh.

Alex M: taking ownership, will update PM notes and ping here with verification logs when done.

Maya R: last item — if anyone needs to swap shifts tonight ping me, I can handle coverage.

Caroline: thanks — handing off. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: reminder: oncall-handoff checklist completed by Maya R — https://redwood.tools/oncall/checklist/1779998888
